findings.title: Reindexing adds a relation to a stratum instead of restricting the stratum, duplicating leading contributions

location.item: Definition (5.6), equation (5.36), Proposition 5.8 proof first paragraph and first unnumbered display p.570

findings.complete_check: r=2,n0=1,N=2^M,mu=[{0,1}],k_mu=k2. Generic exact-zero stratum S0={empty} has empty intersection with k2=0. S1={empty,mu} has nonempty U={(a,0,b):ab!=0,a!=+-b}, witnessed by(1,0,3). Both S0 and S1 are mapped to S1 by S->S union {mu}, so U counted twice rather than once. For Gaussian h compatible with(5.33), alpha_U=2 and its extra normalized sum is N^-2 sum_U exp(-pi(a^2+b^2)/N^2)->1.
assumptions_verified: Allowed r=2 and n0=1; M in stated range
Both original strata nonempty and use exact source primed definition
Point's only zero subset classes are empty and mu
Test Gaussian is Schwartz and satisfies restriction (5.33)
Extra contribution of main-term size, not a boundary effect
findings.counterevidence: Exact Fourier expansion and Proposition 5.8 statement not refuted. Deduplicating target strata would alter the displayed index convention. Correctly restricting original strata gives claimed estimate.
findings.core_dependency: Proposition 5.8 -> Theorem 3.1(3.4) -> variance(8.1) -> density-one Poisson statements.
findings.impact: Demonstrated invalid derivation on core second-moment chain; Major under user calibration; no theorem counterexample.

repair.statement: Retain each original nonempty S-stratum once iff mu in S; discard all other constrained intersections. Do not replace S by S union {mu}.
repair.verification: Set identity proved; existing stratum estimates apply, and alpha<=2^(2r-d-1) bounds normalized errors; finite number of strata.
repair.boundary: Complete independent global theorem proof and author adoption not established.

findings.title: Multiplicity-counting auxiliary function does not satisfy the quoted divisor bound

location.item: Section 2 definition of Omega1 and Section 8 paragraph after(8.2)

findings.complete_check: Omega1 counts multiplicities. h(n)=b(n)2^Omega1(n) is nonnegative multiplicative but h(25)=4>d(25)=3; h(5^a)/d(5^a)=2^a/(a+1) unbounded. Thus cannot apply the stated h<=d result to this h. The target sum/density assertion itself is not disproved.
findings.counterevidence: A broader multiplicative-function theorem might yield the desired estimate, but its hypotheses are not the bound as quoted. Replacing h with b(n)2^omega1(n), with omega1 distinct-prime count, restores all stated hypotheses.
findings.core_dependency: Section 8 proof that the selected radii form a full-density subset, needed for Theorems 1.1 and1.2.
findings.impact: Invalid application on core density chain; Major per specified calibration, despite short repair and survival of estimate.

repair.statement: Use h_*(n)=b(n)2^omega1(n), leaving the paper's definition of Omega1 unchanged.
repair.verification: At every prime power h_*<=a+1. Same prime values, hence sum<=Cx. Since n1 squarefree, Omega1(n1)<=omega1(n); Markov yields O(sqrt(x)+x/(log x)^log2)=o(x/sqrt(log x)).
repair.boundary: Independent acceptance and full global proof remain; adoption not requested or observed.

scope_clarifications.explanation: Unbounded imaginary uniform reading contradicted by degree-J truncated polynomial at y=2^J,z=iT. Prior |z|<=A context and unspecified constant dependence leave bounded interpretation; actual application fixed real powers. Retained unrated pending clarification.

scope_clarifications.item: Distinct J versus distinct points in Lemma7.8
scope_clarifications.explanation: Fixed finite shifts have positive separation, and compact support forces tuple clustering at O(1/N); omitted equal-J/different-shift tuples vanish for sufficiently large N.

unresolved_claims: Intended complex-z uniformity and constant dependence in(4.17)
Entire external-analytic and spacing-transfer proof not independently reconstructed
Limited search cannot exclude all later corrections

independent_acceptance_check.scope: Focused acceptance of both existing Major findings in the publisher version and their explicitly bounded repairs.

checks.result: Exact-zero strata distinguish the generic unconstrained stratum from the constrained one. The displayed map S to S union {mu} counts U twice; (1,0,3) satisfies the exclusions. Gaussian Schwartz data are allowed in Section5, and the extra normalized contribution tends to1. Restricting original strata once restores the stated estimate conditional on its existing lemmas.

The source defines Omega1 with multiplicity but invokes a bound requiring h<=d: h(25)=4>3 and the prime-power ratio is unbounded. Distinct-prime omega1 gives a valid substitute and preserves the density argument because n1 is square-free.
Both defects occur on the explicitly checked second-moment/density-one proof chain. Short validated repairs do not lower their core-derivation severity; the main Poisson theorem is not claimed false.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Both Major findings and repair boundaries supported; no scientific change required.
